## Change

Explain the problem and resulting behavior. Link the relevant issue or agreed scope.

## Validation

State the checks run and their results. Separate software tests, device testing
and visual acceptance; list material unverified gates.

## Documentation

- [ ] Each changed document follows its role in AGENTS.md.
- [ ] Dated OT history belongs only in docs/PROGRESS_LOG.md, with one date heading per day.
- [ ] Capabilities and support claims match linked evidence; no duplicated percentage.
- [ ] No secrets, PINs, private device identifiers or sensitive captures are included.
